name: tezca-kmp-development
description: Kotlin Multiplatform development for Android and iOS: set up a KMP SDK or a Compose Multiplatform app (Koin, Room 3, Ktor, DataStore, kotlinx datetime/serialization/coroutines, lifecycle ViewModel, SKIE, CI/CD to Firebase and the stores) and grow it layer by layer with MVVM feature modules: APIs, Room DAOs, preferences, offline-first repositories, use cases, ViewModels, screens and tests.
